correctness.rationale: The common spectral projectors P_c=product E_j or (I−E_j) are mutually orthogonal and triangular, so the upper unitriangular simultaneous eigenbasis respects diagonal characters. The orbit stabilizer has exactly one free upper entry for equal colors, giving q^{(n²−sum n_c²)/2}. Stirling’s fixed-displacement multinomial normalization and global maximal-multinomial bound give summable discrete Gaussian domination and total-variation convergence. With exactly a colors, Cauchy–Schwarz yields the n² exponent (1−1/a)/2 and a near-balanced occupancy yields the matching lower bound. Independently recomputed exact weighted composition sums for n=2,3, k=1,2 and q=2,3; notably n=3,k=2,q=2 gives 340.
